intro.title: One Platform. Multiple Payment Gateway Integrations.
body: Organisations need flexible and convenient ways to receive payments from donors and supporters. Donorfit brings multiple payment gateway integrations together, helping organisations access supported payment providers according to their requirements.
Whether your organisation operates locally or serves supporters internationally, explore the available payment gateway integrations and choose a provider that meets your payment processing needs.

items.stripe: A global payment platform for card payments and digital wallets. Connected to Donorfit, Stripe processes the online donation payments supporters make through your forms.
items.paypal: One of the most widely used online payment services. Supporters log in to their PayPal account and confirm the payment without entering card details.
items.gocardless: A specialist in bank payments by direct debit, including SEPA and UK Bacs. Well suited to regular giving, membership fees and sponsorships.
items.mollie: A payment provider headquartered in Amsterdam, offering cards and popular local European payment methods such as iDEAL and Bancontact.
items.micropayment: A payment service provider based in Germany, offering payment methods many donors in Germany know, such as direct debit, card payments and prepayment.

gateways.note: The lists show what each provider offers. Which payment methods, countries and currencies are available to your organisation depends on the provider, your account with them and your settings.

methods.title: Multiple Payment Methods for Your Supporters
methods.sub: Online donation payments can be made with the methods your connected provider offers. Available methods depend on the selected payment provider, the country and your account configuration – not every method is available through every gateway.

cards.title: Credit and debit cards
cards.text: Card payments, for example Visa, Mastercard and American Express through Stripe.

wallets.title: Digital wallets
wallets.text: Apple Pay and Google Pay through Stripe, Apple Pay through Mollie.

debit.title: Direct debit
debit.text: SEPA Direct Debit, Bacs Direct Debit in the UK through GoCardless, and direct debit through Micropayment.

paypal.title: PayPal
paypal.text: Supporters pay with their PayPal balance, linked bank account or linked card.

local.title: Local European methods

faq.title: Payment gateway FAQs
faq.sub: Answers about payment gateway integrations for nonprofits and charities. If your question isn’t here, our team is happy to help.

items.question: What payment gateways does Donorfit support?
items.answer: Donorfit integrates with five payment gateways: Stripe, PayPal, GoCardless, Mollie and Micropayment. Each has its own integration page describing the payment methods it offers and what you need before connecting it.

items.question: Does Donorfit offer multiple payment gateway integrations?
items.answer: Yes. Donorfit offers integrations with several payment providers, so your organisation can choose the gateway that suits its supporters, its fundraising activities and the locations it serves.

items.question: Which payment gateway is suitable for international organisations?
items.answer: It depends on where your organisation is registered and where your supporters are. Stripe is a global payment platform for cards and wallets, PayPal is widely used for online payments, Mollie focuses on European payment methods, GoCardless on direct debit in SEPA countries and the UK, and Micropayment on methods familiar to donors in Germany. Always check the provider’s own country and currency coverage for your organisation.

items.question: Can organisations choose their preferred payment provider?
items.answer: Yes. You choose the supported payment provider that fits your organisation, for example based on the payment methods your supporters prefer, the countries you work in and the provider’s fees.

items.question: Which online payment methods are supported?
items.answer: That depends on the provider you connect and what is enabled for your account. Across the integrated providers, the methods offered include credit and debit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay, SEPA and Bacs Direct Debit, PayPal, bank transfer, iDEAL and Bancontact.

items.question: Can donors make donations through different payment gateways?
items.answer: Donors pay with the methods your organisation offers on its Donorfit forms. Whether you can connect more than one provider and offer them side by side depends on your Donorfit setup, so please talk to our team about your requirements.

items.question: Are international payments supported?
items.answer: International donation payments depend on your payment provider: which countries it serves, which currencies it supports and how your account is configured. Donorfit does not guarantee acceptance in every country. Please check the provider’s conditions before launching.

items.question: Are payment gateway transaction fees included in Donorfit?
items.answer: No. Donorfit is free to use, and the payment provider charges its own transaction fees according to its pricing and your agreement with it. Donors can choose to cover the fee if you offer that option.

items.question: How can I connect a payment gateway to Donorfit?
items.answer: Open an account with the provider in your organisation’s name and complete its verification. Then connect that account to Donorfit and complete the configuration the provider requires. Our team can guide you through the process. Activation depends on the provider’s own verification.
